name: Crate of Horseshoes
summary: In Elwynn, fifty iron horseshoes are bound for Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Delivery to Lakeshire
sections.body: Smith Argus forged fifty fresh horseshoes in Goldshire, then packed the crate and hammered it shut. Verner Osgood commissioned them for Lakeshire, where constant pressure from gnolls and orcs leaves local craftsmen reliant on Elwynn for essential metal goods. The delivery answers Verner's desperate need for equipment, and Argus includes a stern bill of sale so the Redridge craftsman knows frontier survival comes at a steep price.

faq.q: What is inside the Crate of Horseshoes?
faq.answer: The crate holds fifty iron horseshoes forged by Smith Argus in Goldshire. An attached bill demands payment from the buyer.
Verner Osgood commissioned the horseshoes. He is a tradesman and craftsman in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, and needs them to keep his work and local draft animals running.
Smith Argus, Goldshire's blacksmith in Elwynn Forest, forged the horseshoes, packed the crate, and prepared it for delivery.

faq.q: Why does Verner need horseshoes from Elwynn?
faq.answer: Hostile Blackrock orcs and gnolls besiege Lakeshire, leaving the frontier settlement isolated and short of raw materials and trade goods. Local workers must bring basic supplies from safer settlements such as Goldshire.

angles.text: The delivery shows the steady demand for basic smithing goods along frontier roads that connect the towns. Lakeshire depends on Goldshire's anvil to keep its draft animals working.
Couriers carrying goods between Elwynn and Redridge keep the kingdom's fragile trade routes open and outlying garrisons equipped, even as Stormwind withholds military reinforcement.
